chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad and another, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Ibn Muskān, from Badr ibn al-Walīd, from Abū al-Rabīʿ al-Shāmī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, the Imam, when he desires to know, is taught.

key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the Imam, the divinely appointed leader

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the knowledge of the Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Imam عليه السلام is granted knowledge whenever he wills to know. It presents the Imam’s knowledge as divinely bestowed and connected to his station of authority.
